row_grain: one frozen-cohort symbol x native 15m decision cutoff in windows A and B

units.price: USDT per native contract unit (contract multiplier/revision not proven)
units.volume: Binance archive contract volume units; not normalized across symbols
units.timestamps: UTC epoch nanoseconds; archive timestamps are UTC epoch milliseconds, normalized to exclusive interval close

availability: RECONSTRUCTED_MARKET; monthly archives fetched after the historical decision time; actual receipt is UNKNOWN_NOT_CAPTURED_AT_ACQUISITION. This output uses the explicit ResearchBar adapter and is not a RawObservationV2 producer.

policy_calls.s1: one-pass TECHNICAL_V1 EMA cache and pointwise implementation of repository pure _regime/_setup math; deterministic synthetic and verified real-prefix parity tests compare against those functions; coordinator/action decision not called
policy_calls.s6: full cross-section producer not called; price-only adapter uses existing S6 score convention and full-window 720 aligned H1 returns; funding/liquidity/universe eligibility omitted

columns.symbol: frozen Binance USD-M USDT convenience cohort member
columns.actual_receipt_status: UNKNOWN_NOT_CAPTURED_AT_ACQUISITION; do not infer from event close, file mtime, or rebuild time
columns.actual_receipt_at_utc_ns: blank because original archive retrieval instant was not instrumented
columns.m15_event_at_utc_ns: archived bar event/close boundary in UTC epoch nanoseconds
columns.m15_replay_available_at_utc_ns: counterfactual replay availability, event close + frozen 5 seconds
columns.feature_replay_available_at_utc_ns: latest required source replay availability + at least 1 second processing latency
columns.replay_visibility_at_cutoff: NOT_VISIBLE_UNDER_CLOSE_PLUS_5S for the exact-close decision row
columns.s1_diagnostic_timing_grade: ZERO_LAG_DESCRIPTIVE_BAR_PREDICATE; not a delayed replay decision
columns.source_status: OBSERVED or SOURCE_MISSING for the native M15 bar that closes at the decision cutoff
columns.source_missing_reason: empty when observed; otherwise OFFICIAL_ARCHIVE_404, NATIVE_SLOT_GAP, or ARCHIVE_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE
columns.h1_archive_sha256: downloaded checksum-verified H1 monthly ZIP SHA-256 for latest completed H1 source row
columns.h1_row_index: physical data row index in the exact monthly CSV member
columns.m15_archive_sha256: downloaded checksum-verified M15 monthly ZIP SHA-256 for current slot
columns.m15_row_index: physical data row index in the exact monthly CSV member
columns.h1_close: latest completed H1 close as of cutoff
columns.h1_return: latest completed H1 log close return when previous H1 is contiguous
columns.h1_ema20: existing TECHNICAL_V1 seeded EMA20 from contiguous year prefix
columns.h1_ema50: existing TECHNICAL_V1 seeded EMA50 from contiguous year prefix
columns.h4_trend: existing S1 `_regime` context from exact UTC closed H1-to-H4 bars
columns.s1_setup_event: 1 only on the H1 row that starts a new contiguous setup origin; repeated unchanged SETUP states are state rows, not new events
columns.s1_setup_event_id: deterministic SHA-256 of symbol, frozen S1 policy identity, H1 cutoff, side, extreme, and prefix ref
columns.s1_setup_event_cutoff_utc_ns: originating H1 setup cutoff, UTC epoch nanoseconds
columns.s1_setup_event_side: direction of the current setup event; blank when no event
columns.s1_setup_event_ref: causal H1/H4 prefix digest for the current setup event
columns.s1_setup_event_extreme: three-bar H1 setup extreme at the new event origin, USDT per native contract unit
columns.s1_trigger_state: BAR_TRIGGER, NO_TRIGGER, NOT_IN_TRIGGER_WINDOW, or SOURCE_MISSING; any missing current M15 row is SOURCE_MISSING, and an active setup also requires a contiguous previous M15 row
columns.s1_reason: reason for unavailable S1 prefix; empty for evaluated existing-code state
columns.s1_side: legacy-compatible descriptive CURRENT precursor side; never the originating trigger side
columns.s1_setup_ref: legacy-compatible descriptive CURRENT precursor prefix digest; never the originating trigger ref
columns.s1_trigger_setup_id: deterministic identity of the setup that owns this trigger opportunity
columns.s1_trigger_setup_cutoff_utc_ns: originating H1 setup cutoff, UTC epoch nanoseconds
columns.s1_trigger_setup_side: originating setup direction; persists across the original four subsequent M15 opportunities, including the next H1 boundary
columns.s1_trigger_setup_ref: causal prefix digest of the originating setup
columns.s1_trigger_setup_extreme: originating three-bar H1 setup extreme, USDT per native contract unit
columns.s1_trigger_m15_cutoff_utc_ns: M15 trigger observation cutoff, UTC epoch nanoseconds
columns.s1_raw_trigger_predicate: 1 for every matching close-vs-prior-high/low bar predicate while setup is active; not independent events
columns.s1_first_trigger_event: 1 only for the earliest raw matching predicate per unique setup ID; later matches remain separately visible
columns.s1_first_trigger_event_id: deterministic SHA-256 of originating setup ID and first matching M15 cutoff
columns.s1_first_trigger_reason: FIRST_MATCH_FOR_SETUP, REPEATED_MATCH_FOR_ALREADY_TRIGGERED_SETUP, PRIOR_TRIGGER_HISTORY_MISSING, NO_MATCH, CURRENT_M15_MISSING, or PREVIOUS_M15_MISSING_OR_NONCONTIGUOUS
columns.s1_diagnostic_grade: S1_BAR_PRECURSOR_DIAGNOSTIC when pure existing setup/regime methods ran
columns.s6_score: existing policy convention: latest 4 matched residual H1 returns divided by trailing residual sample standard deviation
columns.s6_rank: descending price-only fixed-cohort rank if rankable breadth supports it
columns.s6_beta_btc: sample covariance(asset,BTC)/sample variance(BTC), 720 matched H1 returns
columns.s6_residual_volatility: sample standard deviation of 720 matched residual H1 returns
columns.s6_own_4h_trend: existing 50 contiguous closed H4 EMA20/EMA50 context
columns.s6_rankable_breadth: observed fixed-cohort peer count; BTC reference excluded; not exchange-eligible breadth
columns.s6_exclusion_reason: insufficient aligned history or explicit unverified-eligibility limitation
columns.btc_h1_return: BTC context log return at latest completed H1 cutoff
columns.eth_h1_return: ETH context log return at latest completed H1 cutoff
columns.btc_h4_trend: BTC existing H4 context when contiguous; otherwise unavailable
columns.eth_h4_trend: ETH existing H4 context when contiguous; otherwise unavailable
columns.raw_source_refs: compact JSON with archive hashes, S1 prefix hash and S6 H1 source cutoff bounds
columns.h1_source_status: OBSERVED or SOURCE_MISSING for the latest completed H1 source slot used by the current decision cutoff
columns.h1_source_missing_reason: empty when observed; OFFICIAL_ARCHIVE_404, NATIVE_SLOT_GAP, or ARCHIVE_STATUS_UNAVAILABLE when missing

missingness: ASOF_COVERAGE.csv.gz holds every native H1 and M15 slot expected on the same close/decision calendar, including both native slot-open and decision-cutoff keys. M15 missing counts reconcile exactly to the panel; H1 slots are one per hour and H1 as-of states repeat across M15 panel rows. Active S1 trigger opportunities with missing/noncontiguous current or prior M15 input are SOURCE_MISSING, never NO_TRIGGER.
boundary_convention: Decision cutoffs are UTC close boundaries in [begin, final), including 00:00. Each M15 source slot opens decision_cutoff_utc_ns minus 15 minutes; the first decision uses the preceding month seed; no bar closing at or after final is included.
